proposed_change.description: Maintain an orders summary projection keyed by account and reporting window instead of aggregating the full order set on every request.

business_semantics.consistency_invariant: The projection must equal the committed source-of-truth totals for the same account and reporting window after the allowed lag.

maintenance.retry_semantics: Projection events are keyed by source transaction and consumer processing is idempotent.
maintenance.partial_failure_strategy: Failed projection updates remain in the outbox and are retried without changing the source transaction outcome.
maintenance.reconciliation_strategy: A periodic source-versus-projection checksum detects drift and rebuilds affected windows.

cost.write_amplification: One outbox row and one projection upsert per source transaction affecting the summary.
cost.storage: One compact aggregate row per account and reporting window.
cost.operational_complexity: Adds an outbox consumer, lag monitoring, drift detection, and rebuild tooling.

verification.experiment: Shadow-read the source aggregation and the projection for the same requests, compare results, and measure end-to-end database read latency before routing production reads.
success_criteria: p95 read latency is below 80 ms
projection mismatch rate is zero after the 5 second staleness budget
projection consumer lag remains below 5 seconds
verification.rollback: Keep the source aggregation path available behind a feature flag and route reads back to it if latency, lag, or correctness criteria regress.
